description:
Belvoir Birmingham Central are delighted to present this well-appointed two-bedroom apartment in the ever-popular Qube development, located in the heart of Birmingham’s bustling city centre. Offering spacious accommodation, stylish interiors and the added benefit of secure allocated parking, this property is perfect for professionals seeking modern urban living with convenience at its core.

Situated on a high floor with lift access, the apartment features a bright and spacious open-plan living and dining area, with large windows that allow for an abundance of natural light and offer striking city views. The contemporary kitchen is fully fitted with integrated appliances and provides ample cupboard and worktop space, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

Both bedrooms are generously sized doubles, neutrally decorated and well-lit, offering flexible living space for sharers, couples or those needing a home office. The modern family bathroom is finished to a high standard with a full-sized bath, overhead shower, WC and basin, all with sleek, contemporary fittings.

One of the standout features of this apartment is the secure allocated parking space, a highly desirable addition in such a central location where parking is at a premium.

The Qube development is ideally located just off Broad Street and within walking distance of Brindleyplace, The Mailbox, and Birmingham’s central business district. Residents benefit from close proximity to a wide range of amenities including top restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, gyms, and excellent public transport links. Birmingham New Street, Five Ways and Snow Hill stations are all easily accessible, making this an ideal base for commuters.

Early viewing is highly recommended – call now to arrange a viewing! EPC rating: C.
